title: ConfigGetOutput
description: The envelope `duckduckgo-search-cli config get <KEY>` writes on stdout. Carries no `type` discriminator, so a consumer identifies it by the subcommand it invoked. Added in v1.0.3 (GAP-SCHEMA-INTROSPECTION-UNDECLARED-001). English-only: configuration key names are part of the CLI contract and are never translated.

type.description: Envelope discriminator (v1.0.4+). Emitted by `types::ConfigKind::ConfigGet`, a compiler-checked constant rather than a hand-typed literal.

key.description: The key as requested. Echoed so a batched caller can match responses to requests.

present.description: Whether the key is STORED in `config.toml`. False does not mean the knob has no effect: an unset key falls back to the compiled default. Use `config effective` to see the value that actually applies.

value.description: The stored value as a string, or null when `present` is false. Always a string when set: the file is TOML and the CLI reports it verbatim rather than guessing a type.
